class.name: SfxPlayer3D
class.brief_description: Plays the events of an [SfxBank] at its place in the 3D world.
class.description: Plays the events of an [SfxBank]. It is a thin node: the engine behind it ([SfxPlaybackRuntime]) runs on a worker thread of [GndSfxServer], and the player owns the pool of audio nodes it applies the results to. Two kinds of parameters drive events: the player's own ([method set_parameter], declared by the bank, read by every event) and an instance's ([method play]/[method modulate], for that instance only). [codeblock] player.set_parameter(&"speed", velocity.length()) player.play(&"horn") player.stop(&"horn") [/codeblock] Beyond [code]gnd_sfx/hard_cut_distance[/code] of the camera it falls silent the way [member cut] does (checked every [code]gnd_sfx/hard_cut_check_interval[/code] seconds, at once when the camera is switched or has moved farther than [code]gnd_sfx/hard_cut_check_distance[/code] since the last check, and at every [method play]).

method.name: get_event_visualization_state
method.description: A snapshot of the latest instance of [param event_name] for the editor's timelines: [code]playing[/code], [code]event_time[/code], [code]parameters[/code], and per clip [code]active[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]visible_span[/code], [code]loops[/code].

method.name: get_parameter
method.description: The value of a parameter of the player, raw or derived ([member SfxBank.derived_parameters]).

method.name: hard_cut_check
method.description: Cuts or restores the player by its distance to [param camera] (the viewport's camera when omitted).

method.name: is_playing
method.description: [code]true[/code] while [param event_name] has an instance, also a releasing one.

method.name: modulate
method.description: Sets instance parameters of the latest instance of [param event_name]. Prefer [method set_parameter] for a value every event of the bank reads.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts the event [param event_name]. [param offset_or_parameters] is either a time offset in seconds into the event's timeline or a [Dictionary] of instance parameters (then [param parameters] is ignored). Instance parameters override the player's own ([method set_parameter]) for this instance only.

method.name: play_automation
method.description: Starts [param event_name] with [param automation_name] set to [param value], or only sets it when the event already plays (unless [param restart]).

method.name: seek
method.description: Restarts the latest instance of [param event_name] at [param offset] seconds of its timeline.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets a parameter of the player, declared by [member SfxBank.parameters]; every event of the bank reads it. Cheap enough to call every frame: the value is stored and the tick that follows (on a worker thread) works out what changes. An undeclared name is refused with a warning. The same as setting the [code]parameters/<name>[/code] property.

method.name: set_parameter_values
method.description: Sets the raw parameters in their declaration order ([member SfxBank.parameters]), from the first: one call for all of them - what a game feeding many values every step (from C++, through [method Object.call]) should use. Only the values that changed are worked out again.

method.name: set_parameters
method.description: Batch [method modulate]: a [Dictionary] of event name -> parameter [Dictionary].

method.name: stop
method.description: [code]stop()[/code] / [code]stop(true)[/code] stops every event; [code]stop("name")[/code] / [code]stop("name", true)[/code] the latest playing instance of one. Without [param immediate] the instance releases: its event ADSR, its tracks' release and fade-out curves, then its sustain clips.

method.name: stop_automation
method.description: Stops [param event_name] (there is no per-automation stop).

method.name: sync_values
method.description: Applies the exported values to the voice nodes; with [param rebuild] frees the nodes and stops everything first.

members.member: The [SfxBank] whose events this player plays. Assigning it also declares the player's parameters ([member SfxBank.parameters]), shown as [code]parameters/<name>[/code] properties.
The audio bus of every voice node.

Silences the player from outside (e.g. a cab bank when the listener leaves the cab): everything stops at once, [method play] is ignored and its [SfxParameterTrigger]s start nothing. Set back to [code]false[/code], its open [constant SfxParameterTrigger.GATE]s start their events again at [member SfxParameterTrigger.resume_offset]. Combined with the distance cut of [SfxPlayer3D]. Not saved with the scene.
Whether the player falls silent beyond [code]gnd_sfx/hard_cut_distance[/code] of the camera. Off for a player whose events carry their own places ([member SfxSpatialConfig.position]).
How many voices (audio nodes) the player may use at once. A new voice beyond it steals one: a releasing voice first, then a one-shot, then the oldest.
Editor only: the parameter the preview sets to [member playback_automation_value].
Editor only: the value of [member playback_automation] in the preview.
Editor only: the event the preview plays.
Editor only: previews [member playback_effect] in the editor.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when the last voice and instance of the player are gone.
